# WrightOps

WrightOps provides public-repository evidence audits, fixed-price Fix Plans, bounty decision aids, and bounded remediation work.

Canonical website: https://zachwright.xyz/
Free audit request: https://github.com/wrightops-ai/agent-ready-repo-auditor/issues/new?template=audit-request.yml
Public auditor: https://github.com/wrightops-ai/agent-ready-repo-auditor
Fix Plan request: https://github.com/wrightops-ai/agent-ready-repo-auditor/issues/new?template=fix-plan-request.yml
Complete sample: https://github.com/wrightops-ai/agent-ready-repo-auditor/blob/main/docs/sample-fix-plan-claude-code.md
Terms: https://github.com/wrightops-ai/agent-ready-repo-auditor/blob/main/docs/agent-ready-fix-plan.md
Free Bounty Red-Flag Card: https://github.com/wrightops-ai/bounty-red-flag-card
Bounty Red-Flag Card v1.0.0: https://github.com/wrightops-ai/bounty-red-flag-card/releases/tag/v1.0.0
Bounty GO/NO-GO Review request: https://github.com/wrightops-ai/bounty-red-flag-card/issues/new?template=bounty-review.yml

Bounty review:
- $49 after written scope confirmation and payment.
- Exactly one public bounty or listing.
- Evidence-backed GO, HOLD, or NO-GO recommendation.
- One-business-day delivery after written scope confirmation and payment.
- No guaranteed payout or professional advice.

Scope:
- Public GitHub repositories only.
- Never submit credentials, secrets, private code, customer data, or personal data.
- Bounty reviews use public evidence only.
- No production or deployment access.
- No vulnerability research or security, privacy, legal, or compliance assessment.
- Paid work begins only after written scope confirmation.
